title: EU Approves €115 Million Emergency Aid Package for Spain Over Ceuta Crisis
detail: The European Union has formally approved €115 million in emergency aid for Spain to address the ongoing Ceuta border migration crisis, marking the EU's first major financial commitment to the situation. The package follows the European Commission's technical mission dispatch after an earlier Marlaska-Brunner call on EU support.
